responsibility: Holds helper routines shared by the normal and post-reload RTL GCSE implementations, especially logic for recording memory-modifying insns and computing block transparency for expressions in the presence of register defs, calls, and canonicalized MEM dependencies. Its key services build per-block canonical MEM modification lists and clear dataflow bits when an expression’s registers or memory location can be clobbered, allowing gcse-related passes to share alias-sensitive transparency analysis.
same_name_distinction: Provides the shared GCSE helper implementations, while gcc/gcse-common.h only declares the common structs and function interfaces. This .cc file contains the executable routines that collect canonicalized modified MEMs and compute transparency across basic blocks for both pre-reload and post-reload GCSE code.
